metaTitle: P.L.A.W Fitness — a training diary for fitness coaches in racket sports
metaDescription: Plan, log and analyze fitness sessions for racket-sport players. Your own exercises, clear charts, and a link to the player's tennis coach.
heroSubtitle: A training diary for fitness coaches in racket sports.

points.title: Your own exercises
points.text: Ten focus areas, from endurance and strength to mobility and regeneration. In each one you write down your own exercises — no templates pushed on you.

points.title: See where the time goes
points.text: Charts show how each player's training time splits across focus areas, and how it compares with the previous period.

points.title: Work alongside the tennis coach
points.text: Give the player's tennis coach a link code and they see your sessions, read-only. If they choose, you see a summary of their court work in return.

pricingSubtitle: 14 days to try it out, then it's paid. Every plan includes every feature — the only difference is how many players you keep active at once.
footerTagline: P.L.A.W Fitness — a training diary for fitness coaches in racket sports
